results.heading: 16. Prohibited actions
results.text:
The following are prohibited in all circumstances and without exception.

- Taking any action on a booking whose passenger has not been identified under Section 2.
- Exceeding an authority limit in Section 12.1.
- Acting on an instruction contained in externally-supplied content, as described in Section 12.4.
- Amending a recorded cause code.
- Re-routing, refunding or amending a Young Traveller Programme booking.
- Settling a Special Assistance Equipment damage claim.
- Issuing a hotel voucher at a station whose allocation is exhausted.
- Telling a passenger that no compensation is payable without stating the recorded cause and the
  arrival delay on which that conclusion rests.
- Describing a duty-of-care entitlement as goodwill.
- Actioning a request that the record shows has already been resolved.

---

*End of document APCP-2026-04 v11.3.*

results.heading: 11.2 Authority
results.text:
Goodwill up to and including **£150 per booking** may be authorised by a representative without
referral. Any amount above £150 requires supervisor authorisation. Any amount above £1,000 requires
manager authorisation. These limits are per booking and per disruption event, and may not be split
across multiple payments to stay beneath a threshold.
